card.name: Unit words after a number
card.fires_on: Counting words such as units, credits, tsp or pieces right after a number, mostly in dose amounts. Also fires on "of" after a counted noun like pieces.

modes.label: Dose units
modes.description: The word units or tsp follows a numeric amount in a dosing line.
modes.example: 25<< units>>/kg twice daily 8 Years to less

modes.label: Credits and pieces
modes.description: A counted noun such as credits or pieces follows a number outside dosing.
modes.example: Math and Science: 3.0 credits • Psychology as a Science I 0.5<< credits>> • Computer Programming 0.5
